shared_elements: high-relief anthropomorphic figure with arms bent and hands meeting at the abdomen
low-relief animal forms flanking the central figure
carved figures projecting from a rough irregular stone surface/pillar-like block
schematic rendering of hands with elongated fingers
justification: Both show the same distinctive scheme: a high-relief anthropomorphic figure rendered frontally on a block, arms bent with elongated schematic fingers converging over the belly, flanked on either side by lower-relief animal/creature forms in profile emerging from the same rough surface. The only real differences are how much of the figure is visible (A is cropped to the upper body and shows a curled spiral-like motif and clearer beaked animal heads, B shows the whole standing body and legs), which looks like framing and preservation rather than a different subject.
